record.interface_detail: S3-compatible; an HTTP agent at load-s3-agent.load.network with bearer-key auth; load-pools CLI for bulk dataset pushes (explicit HF and GitHub import).
record.tooling: aws-cli / any S3 SDK; pip install load-pools.
record.chaining: The pools CLI is designed for exactly the workload shape. Push an entire existing dataset tree into S3.
record.limits_note: No free allowance. $3/TB/month with an S3 API is at the same price floor as HostBrr.
record.reliability_note: Marketing describes the underlying network as 'fully ruggable' (their own words, in the comparison table). That is an honest durability warning for anything relying on the permanent tier.

evidence.proved: '$0.003 gb/mo', '$11.9 gb permanent', 'S3 storage for 7.7x less than AWS', '1:1 compatible with the S3 interface'
'no longer required to directly contact us to acquire Load S3 access keys'
'pip install load-pools … push entire datasets to Load S3 with support for Hugging Face and GitHub'
